lead verb

also guide, lead the way, all roads lead to Rome

classical

Traupman 324
Traupman 338

dūcō, dūcere, dūxī, ductum

verb, third conjugation

lead, guide; (of a road) lead to

Other words

  • praesum, praeesse, praefuī — lead, be at the head of (+ dat.)

    conjugation · also used · classical

Examples

  • Omnēs viae Rōmam dūcunt.

    All roads lead to Rome.Traupman 338

See also leader, in charge, does this road lead to …?.
